id.description: Unique identifier representing a specific enquiry.

agencyId.description: Identifier representing the agency that owns the listing that the enquiry is for.

receivedAt.description: Date/Time that the enquiry was received by REA Group.

processedAt.description: Date/Time that the enquiry was processed by REA Group.

requestedInformation.description: A list of information the enquirer is asking for.

suppliedMarketStatus.description: The enquirer's description of their market status.

agentRecipients.description: A list of recipients for this enquiry.

fullName.description: Full name of the person sending an enquiry.

email.description: Email address used to contact the person sending an enquiry.

phone.description: Phone number used to contact the person sending an enquiry.

preferredContactMethod.description: Preferred contact method supplied by the person sending an enquiry.

externalProjectId.description: External project identifier setup by CRM / customer.

externalListingId.description: The partner's identifier for the listing. This is used to replace the old `listing.externalListingId` field.

href.description: Hyperlink to a Leads API resource

address.description: [Appraisal requests only] The address of the property.

error.description: Reason why seller enrichment information is not available

description.description: Further details on why seller enrichment information is not available

sellerScore.description: [Pro required] X out of 10 value representing seller enrichment score.

sellerReadiness.description: [Pro required] Value indicating where the consumer is in their sell journey.

buyerReadiness.description: [Pro required] Value indicating where the consumer is in their buy journey.

predicatedSellerSuburb.description: [Pro required, potential seller only] A predicted suburb where the consumer's property to be sold is located

type.description: The type of seller lead that was captured.

agentsContactedCount.description: [Appraisal requests only] Number of agents that received an appraisal request for this property.

leasingPriceExpectation.description: [Appraisal requests only] Weekly rent price expectation provided by property owner at time of request.

leasingTimeframe.description: [Appraisal requests only] Timeframe to lease as provided by property owner at time of request.

sellingPriceExpectation.description: [Appraisal requests only] Sale price expectation provided by property owner at time of request.

sellingTimeframe.description: [Appraisal requests only] Timeframe to sell as provided by property owner at time of request.

propertyPrimaryUse.description: [Appraisal requests only] REA category used to describe how the property is being used as selected by property owner at time of request.

agentPhoneRevealsCount.description: [Pro required, appraisal requests only] Number of phone reveals of agents by the consumer making the original request.

id.description: The id of the enquiry source, e.g campaign id, project profile id or listing id.

name.description: The name of the enquiry source, e.g campaign name, listing page name.

type.description: The type of the enquiry source, e.g campaign type, listing inspection type.
